name: cfd-loss-rates
title: CFD loss-rate series: share of retail accounts losing money, by provider

sources.title: Broker websites: mandated retail risk warning (FCA COBS 22.5; ESMA/CySEC product intervention)
sources.description: One source URL per row, in the source_url column.

fields.name: broker
fields.description: Brand name

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe id

fields.name: entity
fields.description: Legal entity the warning belongs to, as named on the page

fields.name: loss_rate_pct
fields.description: % of retail accounts that lose money, as stated by the firm

fields.name: warning_text
fields.description: The warning sentence, verbatim

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Page the warning was read from (after redirects)

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date the page was read

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: sha256 of the page text plus fetch method and location

fields.name: second_read
fields.description: Independent automated second read of the page (not a person): match, changed, not_found or blocked; empty = not re-read

fields.name: second_read_at
fields.description: Date of the second read, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: second_read_pct
fields.description: Figure the second read found (empty unless match or changed). loss_rate_pct is not overwritten; see cfd-loss-rates-observations.csv

fields.name: second_read_url
fields.description: Page the second read landed on (after redirects)

fields.name: second_read_evidence
fields.description: Saved page text / screenshot in our evidence archive, with sha256

fields.name: second_read_note
fields.description: Why a second read did not match, where it needs saying

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Regulator (from our list, not yet register-checked; 'Not confirmed' when the entity is unconfirmed) and caveats

fields.name: register_url
fields.description: Regulator's public register page for the entity, once checked (empty = not register-checked)

fields.name: register_checked_at
fields.description: Date the regulator register was checked, YYYY-MM-DD (empty = not checked)

fields.name: broker
fields.description: Brand name

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe id, joins to the live file

fields.name: entity
fields.description: Today's entity (not read from each archived page)

fields.name: quarter
fields.description: Calendar quarter of the archive capture, YYYY-Qn

fields.name: loss_rate_pct
fields.description: % of retail accounts that lose money on the archived page

fields.name: archive_url
fields.description: Wayback Machine capture

fields.name: warning_text
fields.description: The warning sentence on the archived page, verbatim

fields.name: broker
fields.description: Brand name

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe id, joins to the live file

fields.name: observed_at
fields.description: Date the page was read

fields.name: loss_rate_pct
fields.description: % of retail accounts that lose money, as read that day

fields.name: warning_text
fields.description: The warning sentence, verbatim

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: Page read (after redirects)

fields.name: read_type
fields.description: first_read (the published reading; '(superseded)' when corrected), uk_browser_read (published) for a corrected figure, or second_read (match/changed)

fields.name: fetch_location
fields.description: Where the page was read from

fields.name: method
fields.description: static (plain HTTP) or js/playwright (headless browser)

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: sha256 of the page text and, for second reads, the saved file
